title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ghdn: dead variables and dead computation in Ack::from_bytes_for and FragmentSender::new
description:
## Issues

### 1. Dead variables in `Ack::from_bytes_for` (lines 304, 306)
```rust
let _rule_id = data[0];                           // unused
let _complete = (data[1] & 0x01) != 0;            // unused
```
- `_rule_id` is never used; `data[0]` is read again on line 341
- `_complete` is never used; `complete` is hardcoded to `false` on line 341
- The `complete` bit from the wire is silently ignored

### 2. Dead computation in `FragmentSender::new` (lines 456-457)
```rust
let _mic = compute_mic(payload);                  // computed and discarded
let _count = if payload.is_empty() {              // computed and discarded
    1
} else {
    payload.len().div_ceil(TILE_SIZE)
};
```
- `_mic` is recomputed at line 466
- `_count` is recomputed at line 465 (with a simpler expression since `is_empty()` already checked)

## Fix
Remove the dead variables and redundant computations.
